mapper.select: SELECT participant_id, restaurant_id FROM SELECTION WHERE participant_id = #{participantId}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO SELECTION s USING (SELECT #{participantId} AS participant_id, #{restaurantId} AS restaurant_id FROM dual) src ON (s.participant_id = src.participant_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET s.restaurant_id = src.restaurant_id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (selection_id, participant_id, restaurant_id) VALUES (SEQ_SELECTION.NEXTVAL, src.participant_id, src.restaurant_id)
